trans-unit.source: This is a tutorial to help you get started with the application.
Click this button to open the settings menu.

This buttons lets you change the language.

Currently, English and German are supported.
If you want to see this tutorial again, click this button.
Here you can choose between different display methods.
This button opens the calculator. It helps you to build everything you need to display a hologram.
This button toggles the fullscreen mode. In fullscreen mode, the application will use the whole screen, hiding the browser's address bar and other elements.
This button opens the imprint containing some legal information about this page.

This button opens the GitHub page of this project. Here you can find some help, the source code and more.

If you want to, you can help me to improve this project by contributing to it there.
You have finished the tutorial. I hope you enjoy creating holograms!
Extra values used by the calculator

This calculator calculates the size of the rectangles you need to build your mirror. Therefore it uses the settings from the Settings menu as far as possible, but some values are not available there. You can set them here.
Here you can set the physical DPI (or PPI) of your display. You can either look this value up or calculate is using your screen size and resolution.

The JavaScript pixel ratio represents the ratio of the size of one CSS pixel to the size of one physical pixel on your device. The default value should be correct, but you can double check it on websites like mydevice.io.

This is the angle by which the mirror is tilted. A greater angle means that you look on the mirror from a higher position. A lower angle means a lower viewing point. The value of 45 degrees means that you look at it in one line with the table.
The calculated image showing the trapeze

The image you can download here shows the template to build your mirror. You will need of these rectangles. The image is generated using the values you entered in the Settings Menu. If you want to change these values, please go back to the Settings Menu.

Make sure to print the image at the correct size. The image is x inches or x cm. This often means to scale the image to more than 100% of its original size. If you print the image at 100% of its original size, it can be too small. Make sure to use the correct size.
Upload the images you want to show with this application.
--- You have not uploaded any images yet. ---
The images can be brightened up and darkened automatically based on their layer number. If you want to change the brightness values, click the button.
This compensates for the fact that the images in the lower layers are less visible than the images in the upper layers, due to the light absorption of the mirror material.
Save the current settings in a file on your PC.
You can also load previously save settings from your PC.
With this setting you can adjust the number of layers.
You can use as many images as there are layers. If you use less images, the last layers will stay empty.

The image you can download here shows the template to build your mirror. You will need of these trapezes. The image is generated using the values you entered in the Settings Menu. If you want to change these values, please go back to the Settings Menu.
Size of the polygon in the middle
Set the size of the polygon in the middle here.
This value is determined by the surface area of your mirror.
With this setting you can adjust the number of sides the polygon has.
Each side displays an image. The number should be between 3 and 10.
You can use as many images as the polygon has sides. If you use fewer images, the images will be repeated.
